months.note: 국내에서 기록된 달이며, 봄(3–5월) 기록이 가장 많고 제주에서는 겨울에 머무는 개체도 있다.

summary: 북미, 북유럽, 중부 유럽, 서부 시베리아, 오스트레일리아, 뉴질랜드, 남부 아프리카에서 번식하고 미국 남부, 아프리카 북서부, 남아프리카, 일본 등지에서 겨울을 나는 제비갈매기다. 같은 무리의 다른 제비갈매기들보다 덩치가 크다.
young: 어린새는 겨울깃 어른새처럼 이마와 정수리가 흰 바탕에 검은 얼룩으로 덮이고, 등·어깨깃·셋째날개깃에 갈색 무늬가 섞여 얼룩덜룩하며, 첫째날개깃과 꽁지가 어른새보다 어둡다.

art.subject: Caspian Tern (Hydroprogne caspia), adult in breeding plumage, as seen on Korean coasts on spring passage (April–May): flat black cap from the bill base to the nape, slightly shaggy at the rear but without a crest; face, neck and underparts white; mantle and upperwings pale grey; underside of the outer primaries blackish, forming a dark wedge under the wingtip; rump and tail pale grey-white; bill massive, bright red with a small dark mark near the tip; dark eye; legs short and black.
art.scene: Korean west-coast estuary sandbar at low tide in spring (April–May); no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding, side view standing: very large, heavy tern, black cap without a crest, pale grey back, massive red bill with a dark mark near the tip, short black legs, short tail falling well short of the wingtips
adult, in flight seen from below, head, body and tail in line: white body and underwing coverts, blackish undersides to the outer eight primaries, short shallow-forked tail, red bill
art.build: Very large, heavy-bodied tern, about the size of a Black-tailed Gull, with a large head, thick neck and long, broad wings. Bill huge, thick and dagger-shaped, about as long as the head and deep at the base. Legs short and black. At rest the wingtips extend well beyond the short tail. Tail short, only shallowly forked, without streamers. Flight gull-like with slow wingbeats, the blackish undersides of the outer primaries contrasting with the white underwing coverts.
avoid: Do not paint a yellow bill and a shaggy crest; those suit Greater Crested Tern (Thalasseus bergii).
Do not give it long tail streamers or a deep fork; the tail is short.
Do not make it small or slim like Common Tern; it is gull-sized with a huge bill.
